11.DSCR:
A $$次元力$$ extraction system developed by $$アンブローン・ジウス$$ of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$. Its name is short for 'Zodiac Of New Energy.'
It is installed along ley lines to extract the Earth's $$次元力$$, but in $$インサラウム$$, the runaway of $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ caused the land itself to die.
During the $$再世戦争$$, five units were installed on Earth and one on Mars; they still exist today, but all of them have ceased functioning.

15.DSCR:
The Japan located on the southern side of the two Japanese archipelagos.
It became a colony of the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$, and its name of 'Japan' was once taken from it, but with the reorganization of the Earth Federation, it newly gained the name '$$新日本$$'.

proofread.reason: rules: double quotes changed to single quotes (quote marks around a name/title)

17.DSCR:
Hunters who exterminate the hostile alien species called 'Beasts' that appear through spacequakes and dimensional tremors.
An alien species is only classed as a Beast if it disturbs this world's ecosystem. Further, hunters only handle those small in scale and confined to a specific area. On that basis Dimensional Beasts, which are large in scale and appear worldwide, fall outside a $$ビーストハンター$$'s remit.
The Rocky Mountains of North America hold spots where the dimensional boundary is unstable and Beasts appear often, so many professional hunters make their homes nearby.

31.DSCR:
One of the parallel worlds (= the world of 'Super Robot Wars Z').
The name is short for '$$宇宙世紀$$ World'.
In the chaos immediately after the $$大時空震動$$, the $$多元戦争$$ broke out.
It is marked by violent displacement of land by spacequakes: apart from places such as the Japanese archipelago, the shape of its continents changed drastically from the old Earth.

proofread.reason: addition: Japanese says nihon rettou nado o nozoki ('except the Japanese archipelago and the like'), not 'a few other places'

33.DSCR:
The independent unit that brought $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$ to an end.
Short for 'Z Emergency Union of Terrestrial Human', meaning 'Earth Human Emergency Rescue Union'.
It fought $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, who sought to control the multiverse as his desires dictated.
After the $$多元戦争$$ ended, it regrouped for the battle against the Executors.
Later, some of its members were displaced to $$ＡＤＷ$$ by the spacequake 'Calamity Birth' that accompanied the appearance of the $$破界の王$$ there. They too fought through the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$ in $$ＡＤＷ$$ before returning to $$ＵＣＷ$$ through the $$アビス$$.

52.DSCR:
A quantum computing system that forms the foundation of $$イオリア$$ Schoenberg's plan.
Possessing information-processing power beyond comparison with ordinary computers, it was a great source of strength enabling $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ to fight against the entire world.
However, with $$リボンズ・アルマーク$$'s cooperation, $$ヴェーダ$$ was seized by $$アレハンドロ・コーナー$$, and after his death it fell into $$リボンズ$$'s hands.
Its main body is located inside the mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.

53.DSCR:
A great power born from the union of two great nations that the $$大時空震動$$ left occupying the North American continent at the same time: the Holy Britannian Empire and the $$ユニオン$$ ($$ユニオン$$ of Solar Energy and Free Nations).
It boasted the largest force in $$ＡＤＷ$$ until the Earth Federation was founded, and even afterwards those from the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$ carried considerable political weight.

56.DSCR:
Mysterious life forms that appeared from another dimension between the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$.
Their official name, 'Dimension-Armed MONster,' was abbreviated to $$ダモン$$, but once multiple types were confirmed, the $$アクシオン$$ Foundation's Institute for Extradimensional Life Research, ADiCR (the A-DiC Institute), carried out a new classification of names.
Their true nature is a form in which a mobile weapon and its pilot's life have been fused together by the effect of the Revive Cells generated by $$ガイオウ$$, the $$破界の王$$. Through Dimensional Beastification (= Violation), combat strength rises dramatically. Dimensional Beasts also have ranks, and depending on the original unit, pilot, and combat strength, they transform into one class or another.
It is impossible to restore a Dimensional-Beastified unit and pilot to their original state, and the pilot's consciousness is basically extinguished. For this reason there is no way to communicate with a $$次元獣$$, but they obey $$ガイオウ$$'s orders and act in an organized manner under his command.
ADiCR is the authority on $$次元獣$$ research, and it was here that the name $$ダモン$$ was coined. However, much of the data brought here by Foundation president $$カルロス$$ $$アクシオン$$ Jr. was in fact collected by the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$, a nation on a parallel-world Earth that had previously been destroyed by Dimensional Beasts, and the names of the various classes are also ones that were used in $$インサラウム$$.

57.DSCR:
An enormous spacequake that occurred in a certain world.
Its shock collapsed the walls separating every parallel world, and a great many multiverses came into being.
It is held to have been caused by the runaway of a weapon called a $$時空震動弾$$, though much about the bomb's developer and the origin of the technology remains a mystery.
Those present at the site of the $$大時空震動$$ are called singularities, and are considered indispensable to the $$時空修復$$ that would reconstitute the multiverse.

60.DSCR:
A mysterious power granted by a holder of a Code.
Its nature differs with the bearer, so the abilities vary widely.
$$ルルーシュ$$'s $$ギアス$$ is the 'power of absolute obedience', letting him force a command on anyone whose eyes he meets. Gaps in memory are seen around the moment a $$ギアス$$ is cast and while it is active. The ability can be used on any one person only once.
A $$ギアス$$ grows stronger the more it is used, and eventually enters a range the bearer cannot control. Past that point the $$ギアス$$ sigil appears in both eyes, and a bearer in that state can inherit a Code from its holder.

103.DSCR:
Full name $$アイム#keyword$$ Liard.
Holder of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and the man who pilots the mobile weapon $$アリエティス$$.
In the $$破界事変$$ he summoned $$ガイオウ$$, $$破界の王$$, to sow chaos in the world, and worked in the shadows as a staff officer of the $$新帝国インペリウム$$.
He was believed killed in the battle at the South Pole late in the $$破界事変$$, but that death was a mimicry produced by his $$スフィア$$'s power.
For his own ends he supplied dimensional science to $$インサラウム$$'s $$アンブローン・ジウス$$. Most of his intent is unknown, but behind his joining of the two worlds through the $$アビス$$ late in the $$再世戦争$$ there seems to lie something beyond merely hunting other $$スフィア$$ holders.
The $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$ governs human falsehood, and its holder's words and deeds are so full of lies that his true feelings are hard to grasp. He is also half absorbed into the $$スフィア$$, and when his emotions run high he becomes unable to say anything true - that is, anything meaningful.
$$アイム#keyword$$ Liard is an alias; his real name is Hermal Argo. He was originally a researcher of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and his aptitude led to the $$スフィア$$ absorbing him.
Late in the $$再世戦争$$ he was neutralized by $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ wielding the $$スフィア$$ of the Inquisitive Goat, the natural predator of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and met his end at the hands of $$ユーサー$$ $$インサラウム$$, ruler of the Holy $$インサラウム$$ Kingdom he had been using.

111.DSCR:
A film depicting the battle 12,000 years ago between the $$堕天翅$$ tribe and those who piloted the $$神話型アクエリオン$$. Based on mythology, it is a love story themed around the love between $$アポロン$$, the reincarnation of a $$堕天翅$$ hero, and $$シルフィ$$.
Note that 'Aqueria' refers to $$アクエリオン$$ itself.
Though the film itself is nothing special, the theme song sung by its lead actress $$アリシア$$, who played $$シルフィ$$, has been highly acclaimed.

proofread.reason: rules: single quotes for titles/terms, not double quotes

112.DSCR:
A metal used on Planet Gabar in the $$ロボット帝国$$, which does not exist on Earth.
It is used as the armor material for $$トライダーＧ７$$.

121.DSCR:
A concept said to record the past and future of all phenomena.
Accessing it is said to be equivalent to leaving the material world and obtaining infinity that transcends time.

125.DSCR:
A book written by $$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$, the former president of Paradigm Corporation.
It is said to depict the end of the world that occurred more than 40 years ago, but the truth of this is unknown.
